title: Discover Scuba Experience
description: Experience scuba diving in a controlled shallow-water environment with guidance from professional instructors. Learn how basic scuba equipment works, practice breathing through a regulator, and discover essential underwater communication signals. This introductory session is designed for beginners and includes supervised underwater activities.

program.activity: Welcome, participant briefing, and safety instructions
Introduction to scuba equipment and breathing techniques

title: Deep Water Exploration Session
description: Explore a specially designed deep-water diving environment featuring submerged platforms, artificial underwater formations, and observation structures. Qualified divers guide participants through controlled exploration exercises while explaining underwater navigation, buoyancy management, and communication techniques.

title: Underwater Photography Workshop
description: Discover the fundamentals of underwater photography through demonstrations and practical exercises. Learn about waterproof camera systems, underwater lighting, image composition, and color correction. Explore techniques used to photograph marine animals and underwater environments.

program.activity: Camera equipment and waterproof housing demonstration
Lighting, composition, and underwater color techniques
Guided camera practice and image review

title: Coral Reef Discovery Tour
description: Join a guided educational tour exploring coral reef ecosystems and the marine species that depend on them. Discover how coral reefs form, why they support marine biodiversity, and which environmental changes threaten their survival. Observe detailed reef displays and learn about conservation initiatives.

program.activity: Welcome and introduction to reef ecosystems
Marine biodiversity and reef species presentation

title: Professional Diving Demonstration
description: Watch experienced diving professionals demonstrate advanced underwater movement, buoyancy control, navigation techniques, and team communication. The demonstration takes place in a transparent deep-water pool, allowing visitors to observe the divers from dedicated viewing platforms.

title: Ocean Conservation Workshop
description: Learn about the environmental challenges affecting marine ecosystems and the actions used to protect ocean habitats. The workshop covers plastic pollution, coral reef degradation, endangered marine species, and sustainable ocean practices through interactive educational activities.

program.activity: Marine pollution and habitat protection presentation
Conservation solutions and responsible visitor practices

title: Underwater Obstacle Challenge
description: Take part in a supervised underwater activity course featuring navigation hoops, submerged pathways, and controlled movement challenges. Participants complete a sequence of underwater tasks focused on coordination, buoyancy, and navigation while instructors monitor safety throughout the session.

program.activity: Welcome, safety briefing, and course explanation

title: Freediving Introduction
description: Discover the basic principles of freediving through an instructor-led introduction to underwater movement, relaxation, breathing awareness, and essential safety procedures. The session includes dry-land education and supervised shallow-water demonstrations suitable for introductory learning.

program.activity: Introduction to freediving and safety principles
Breathing awareness and relaxation exercises on land

title: Deep Sea Creatures Experience
description: Explore the unusual animals and environments found in the deepest parts of the ocean. Discover how marine organisms survive under extreme pressure, limited food availability, and complete darkness. The exhibition features deep-sea imagery, bioluminescence demonstrations, and interactive scientific displays.

title: Diving Equipment Masterclass
description: Explore the main components of modern scuba diving equipment and learn how they support underwater activities. Professional instructors demonstrate regulators, diving cylinders, buoyancy control devices, masks, fins, and dive computers while explaining equipment preparation and maintenance principles.

program.activity: Buoyancy devices and dive computer overview

title: Marine Photography Exhibition
description: Discover a curated collection of underwater photographs featuring coral reefs, marine animals, ocean landscapes, and scientific expeditions. The exhibition combines large-format photography with explanations of underwater imaging techniques and marine environmental research.

program.activity: Coral reef and marine wildlife photography gallery
Underwater photography techniques and equipment presentation

title: Ocean Lights Evening Show
description: Attend an evening audiovisual presentation combining underwater imagery, synchronized lighting, ocean-inspired sound effects, and illuminated marine installations. The show transforms the Ocean Discovery Tunnel into an immersive environment featuring moving projections of marine life and underwater landscapes.

program.activity: Ocean light and underwater projection sequence
Final visual sequence and show conclusion
